MLK 16->15, Juneteenth 13->16 (pageviews reflect 'what is Juneteenth' lookups; 3% favorite, 57% popularity). Diwali 17->23 (US fame only 58%, popularity 32%; the computed rank comes from global Wikipedia readers). confidence: High for 1-5 (Christmas, Thanksgiving, Halloween, July 4 and Easter make up the top 5 of every favorite poll). Medium for 6-16, where order depends on metric: like%/participation favor Mother's Day, Veterans and Memorial Day, and favorite polls favor New Year's and Valentine's. Low-medium for 17-24, which rest on YouGov Ratings popularity plus pageviews; slots 17-24 are close to tied (computed 16.4-20.0). Caveats: the newest favorite-holiday poll is YouGov Feb 2024 (no 2025/26 favorite poll was found); Harris is from 2015 and lists only 6; NRF's Thanksgiving slot is imputed from a different YouGov survey; Wikipedia pageviews are global and skewed, so several moves override them. Talker/OnePoll, Gallup and Visual Capitalist (403) gave no usable favorite-holiday ranking.
